Package com.cdarobotics.cdalib.devices.sensors

Class RevColorSensorV3Device

java.lang.Object
com.cdarobotics.cdalib.devices.Device
com.cdarobotics.cdalib.devices.sensors.RevColorSensorV3Device
public class RevColorSensorV3Device extends Device
A fast Device for the REV Color Sensor V3 (Broadcom APDS-9151).

The stock SDK path reads each channel with a separate I2C transaction, and I2C devices are not covered by Lynx bulk caching — so polling colour, proximity and distance the normal way costs several blocking round-trips per loop. This device instead pulls proximity plus all three colour channels off the sensor in a single 14-byte I2C read of the raw register window (0x08–0x15), then decodes red/green/blue, distance and HSV in software. One hardware transaction per update() instead of many is the loop-time win.

To reach the raw I2C client the SDK hides behind RevColorSensorV3, the deviceClient field is read reflectively once at construction. All getters return the values cached by the most recent update().

The channel scaling and the optical-to-distance curve are reproduced from the SDK's own RevColorSensorV3 implementation, so normalized colours and distance match what the stock driver would report at the same gain.

  • Method Details

    • setGain

      public RevColorSensorV3Device setGain(float gain)
      Sets the software gain applied to the normalized colour channels (default 20). Higher gain brightens dim readings; this is the same multiplier the stock driver uses, applied here in software, so it does not add a hardware transaction.
